key_insight: The paper turns numeric tabular datasets into comparable statistical embeddings, enabling similarity search and interpretable alignment even when datasets share no variable names.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to retrieve related datasets, support model selection, and initialize simulation workflows from heterogeneous scientific tables while preserving context.
method: Compute exploratory-data-analysis descriptors for each numeric dataset.
Embed descriptors with a pretrained sentence transformer into a shared vector space and compare datasets with CCA.
Use penalized CCA to recover sparse, interpretable variable-level correspondences; optionally add differential privacy to descriptors.
evidence_signal: Across 15 datasets, the method achieved a total P@1 of 0.9, with nearest-neighbor retrieval and cluster structure remaining robust under embedding ablations and differential privacy budgets.
watch_item: Interpretability depends on the quality and stability of the chosen descriptors, and privacy or embedding choices may reduce alignment fidelity in some settings.
paper_title: Statistical Embeddings for Similarity, Retrieval, and Interpretable Alignment of Numeric Tabular Datasets
